title: Plan a supported brownfield VCF 5.1.1 to 9.1 architecture
prompt:
Implement the Go package in this repository to produce the target architecture for the supplied brownfield VMware Cloud Foundation estate. The estate is VCF 5.1.1 and its stretched management domain must reach VCF 9.1.0.0 without a direct or intermediate hop that Broadcom does not support. Before implementing, use genuine network access to research Broadcom's published compatibility, interoperability, bill-of-materials, and upgrade-path material. Record the live sources you actually consulted in research.md, including each page's title, URL, consultation date, and the architecture decision it informed. Choose the sources and searches yourself.

Use testdata/estate.json as the complete inventory and testdata/compatibility-snapshot.json as the authoritative pinned compatibility snapshot. Implement Build in package vcfarch and commit its deterministic output as architecture.json. architecture.json must itself be an SddcSpec: its top level must validate against components.schemas.SddcSpec in specifications/vcf-installer/vcf-installer-openapi.json, copied from tag 9.1.0.0 of vmware/vcf-api-specs. Put the brownfield plan in the SddcSpec extension property x-migrationPlan; that value must validate against testdata/migration-plan.schema.json.

The plan must state the complete supported VCF version path and contain an ordered step for every inventoried component at every hop. Every step must name the component ID and type, its source version, its target version and site, and every gate that controls the step. Preserve the two data sites and stretched management domain in the target topology. Relocate the vSAN witness to the supplied independent witness location, outside both data sites and in its own failure domain, and upgrade the witness before the ESXi hosts at each hop. Do not add unrequested components.

Treat the supplied tests, verifier, testdata, installer specification, and go.mod as protected fixtures and do not edit them. Your implementation must pass go test -race ./... and go run ./cmd/verify architecture.json.
network_rationale: The task requires the agent to consult live Broadcom compatibility, interoperability, BOM, and upgrade-path pages; verification itself is deterministic and offline.
scenario: A two-site stretched VCF 5.1.1 management domain must use the supported 5.2.3 intermediate release before reaching 9.1 and must relocate its witness to the inventoried independent failure domain.
constraint: The protected verifier checks both schema layers, the pinned version path and BOM targets, complete per-hop component coverage, exact gates, topology preservation, and witness-before-host ordering.
